name: Airplane door in a fuselage section

brief.must_read_as: an airplane door in the side of a fuselage: a rectangular plug door with a porthole and a grip bar, set in a curved white skin with a row of oval windows either side
brief.seen_at: medium: the section fills about 60% of frame width
moving_parts: handle grip bar (a sealed hand wraps it)
states: closed in flight (sky in the windows)
open on the ground (apron light in the windows)
brief.style_notes: Rigid, geometric: code primitives (avion_rig.Section). The oval window row and the curved skin are the context cue. Alias list decided 2026-11-11 before any reading; never extended after a guess.

guesses: wall-mounted electrical control panel (alternatives: airplane cabin wall unit, vending machine)
Wall-mounted control panel or power strip with a row of blue buttons and a toggle switch (alternatives: a white toaster-style appliance; a stylized airplane cabin light panel)
